killedBy: shell bounce-trail vocabulary (issues #688, #774) clamps to the renderer budget at both ends
why: Re-anchored for #774 on the direct-count line. The per-shell cap is what bounds the renderer's instance buffer (64 shells x MAX_TRAIL_SEGMENTS), and a row too long to count at a glance stops being a count; a shell configured with more bounces must clamp rather than grow.
